title: Program question requirements
description: The quick-questions milestone's program-requirements layer: a committed, reviewed decision listing which generic-question ids each program's application actually needs. The layer SELECTS from generic-questions.json — the single source of truth for question DEFINITIONS — it never defines questions of its own. Each program may also name committed form registries (kb/forms/*.json): the engine unions the registries' spec_question_id links into the program's required universe, so requirements grow with the forms as they are mapped.

default_programs.description: The programs a session targets unless said otherwise — the honest counter's M is computed over their union.

form_registry_ids.description: Committed form-registry entries (kb/forms/*.json) whose spec_question_id links join this program's required universe.

required_question_ids.description: Question-spec ids this program's application asks. Every id must exist in generic-questions.json — the requirements layer selects, never defines.

rationale.description: The reviewed, honest reason for this list — what the application asks and what was deliberately left to the talk stage.
